agda.facts: Current 2.8.0.2 release fixes distribution issues; upstream explicitly tells installed 2.8.0 users that upgrading is unnecessary. No old-line EOL calendar is inferred.

alire.facts: API latest stable is 2.1.1, described as a maintenance release. No formal multi-line lifecycle promise was found in the inspected material.

anki.facts: Latest 26.09.4 release is dated 2026-11-04 and recommends prompt upgrade for security fixes. The security document gives a reporting policy, not a maintained-version matrix.

ansible.facts: ansible-core maintains latest plus two previous major releases. Release API identifies 2.22.0 on 2026-11-02; maintained line points therefore require 2.22, 2.21 and 2.20 evidence.

ant.facts: Official site lists Ant 1.10.18 and Ivy 2.6.0 as current. Ant 1.9.x reached EOL in June 2024; upstream directs users to maintained 1.10.x.

arduino.facts: Current stable Arduino CLI release is 1.5.1. No multi-line EOL schedule was found in inspected release/security material.

blender.facts: Current maintained LTS lines are 5.2 and 4.5. The program promises fixes for two years. These are separate execution targets; an extension minimum-version declaration is not proof.

buf.facts: API current stable release is 1.75.0. Inspected release/security endpoint material does not establish a maintenance set for old Buf points. No EOL claim about 1.73.0 is made.

bun.facts: Security policy supports 1.x.x. API latest release is 1.4.4; executed point 1.4.2 is distinguished from it.

bundler.facts: Ruby 4.0 and 3.4 receive normal maintenance; 3.3 receives security maintenance. Ruby 3.2 and older are EOL. Historical success is separate from maintained-line coverage.

cabal.facts: Upstream documents a three-year GHC support window. Latest cabal-install is 3.18.2.0. This policy is not itself proof of this purifier executing each GHC line.

calibre.facts: Security fixes ship with ordinary releases. Latest API/official release is 9.18.0 on 2026-11-06. No older maintained branch matrix is promised by the inspected security policy.
